faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Institute of Technology Rourkela (NIT Rourkela) for a project-based research position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under the Department of Computer Science and Engineering / IT related project.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled application via email is 12 October 2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply via email by sending a single PDF file containing the completed application and all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess M.Tech, M.E., M.Sc., MCA, or B.Tech/B.E. in relevant disciplines like Computer Science, IT, or equivalent with a valid GATE or NET score.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 28 years, with age relaxations provided for reserved categories as per rules.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary of INR 37,000/- per month for the first two years and INR 42,000/- per month for the subsequent years, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for NIT Rourkela JRF?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting of candidates based on merit and project requirements, followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can find the direct link to the official notification PDF in the Important Links section of this article and on the official website nitrkl.ac.in.
